name: smwsprites-fuel-powered-platform-v1
title: Fuel-powered Platform v1.1
description:
This is a Custom Combustion Platform. Inspired by Tanked Up Trouble, a level from DKC1.



Basically a Platform that needs fuel points to move. ocasionally, the platform will blow one fuel point. When the fuel counter reaches ZERO,it will instantly fall off screen. the max oil the counter can accumulate is 5.



This doesn't require credit since i just fast-forward every game's credits.
